 Derrick White puts up 19 points in win over Raptors 
 by Garrett Ball | Celtics Correspondent | Thu, Nov 12th 2026, 9:15am EST 
 Derrick White scored 19 points (7-15 FG, 3-7 3P, 2-2 FT) with a rebound, seven assists, a steal, and a block in the Celtics’ 98-93 win over the Raptors on Wednesday. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 White led the team in blocks and came second in scoring. It was a nice bounce back after two games below 10 points, and if he’s able to get a bigger workload in upcoming games, could find his way back to fantasy starter territory.
